zones.label: Leaderboard
facts: Ranks every student by a running total
Strugglers see the same low rank week after week
Highest risk of discouraging the students who need encouragement most
Best reserved for confident, evenly-matched groups

zones.label: Friendly Competition
facts: Scored by team, not by individual name
Re-pairs teams between rounds so no student stays 'on the losing team' all session
Framed with humour rather than stakes
Gives a quick energy boost without a lasting scoreboard

zones.label: Collaborative Challenge
zones.summary: One shared goal, no ranking at all.
facts: Requires combining multiple students' skills into one outcome
No student can finish it alone
Builds group identity instead of rivalry
Safest choice for a mixed-confidence group
